notes: "When another person will continue in HUANDENG, send the complete working folder. It contains deck.pptd, page files, original media, supporting sources and project history. Sending only deck.pptd leaves referenced material behind. The diagram names the actual project parts and the next editing action. A PDF or PPTX is useful for delivery, but returning to this shared project requires its working folder."

designIntent.purpose: Hand off the complete folder so another person can continue editing.
designIntent.requestedChange: Teach an actionable Editor workflow through clear pictures and a focused narrative.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
